title: New Movies
article:
Moana 2 is coming out. This is a story about a young girl who is called to the sea, Moana is tasked with a call from the ancestors to reunite all the people of the islands of Oceania by setting foot on one specific island.

Toy Story 5 is coming out, this story is about a few talking toys that go through different exciting journeys,The toys are back in Disney and Pixar's “Toy Story 5” and this time around it's Toy meets Tech. Buzz, Woody, Jessie, and the rest of the gang's jobs get exponentially harder when they go head to head with this all new threat to playtime.

Frozen 3 is coming out, this is a story about two sisters and one has powers,With Anna now ruling as Queen of Arendelle and Elsa looking after the Enchanted Forest, a new villain could interrupt the peaceful give-and-take dynamic between the respective lands.

Wicked the movie is coming out, this is about how in 1939, after Dorothy the Wicked Witch of the West and all of Oz celebrates her defeat, Glinda, the Good Witch of the North, tells the story of the Wicked Witch, whose real name was Elphaba Thropp. Elphaba was born to Melena Thropp, and upon aging into young adulthood, she and her younger paraplegic sister Nessarose attend a prestigious college in Oz called Shiz University, run by the enigmatic Madame Morrible.
author: Almah Zach
